children: Prudential Financial plans to sell its stake in South African financial services firm Alexander Forbes Group in two deals valued at a combined $185 million, as part of its shift away from emerging markets.

Under the transactions, Alexforbes would repurchase about 372.8 million shares held by New Veld, Prudential's indirect subsidiary. ARC AF Holdings Proprietary would also acquire about 74.1 million shares from New Veld, Prudential said Friday.

The deals are part of Prudential's recent efforts to narrow its geographic footprint by exiting emerging markets. The strategy, disclosed in August, aims to focus the company's capital and talent in areas where it sees the strongest opportunities to compete in the long term.
The deals are expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to approval from Alexforbes shareholders and regulators, as well as customary closing conditions.
